name: cimoxide
description: SHACL validation, hover, go to definition and completion for ENTSO-E CGMES and Network Code RDF/XML

cimoxide.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to a `cimlsp` binary. Empty: the one bundled with the extension, else `cimlsp` on `PATH`.

cimoxide.validation.common.markdownDescription: Run the common cross-profile checks (`cimcli validate --common`).

cimoxide.validation.quality.markdownDescription: Run the CIMdesk modelling-quality checks (`cimcli validate --quality`).

cimoxide.validation.silence.markdownDescription: Rule ids not to report (`cimcli validate --silence`).

cimoxide.validation.onType.markdownDescription: Revalidate while typing, not only on open and save. Each run validates the whole model set — every CIM file in the document's directory.

cimoxide.schema.rdfsDir.markdownDescription: RDFS directories to load class tables from instead of the built-in ones (`CIMOXIDE_RDFS_DIR`; a `PATH`-style list).

cimoxide.schema.shaclDir.markdownDescription: SHACL directories to load shapes from instead of the built-in ones (`CIMOXIDE_SHACL_DIR`; a `PATH`-style list).

cimoxide.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the language server.
